name: envelope-change-set-without-baseline
description: A change set with no `baseline`. The token is required by the request shape itself, so an implementation cannot offer a 'just apply it' path by leaving it out: `protocol.schema.json` rejects the envelope before any registry or authorization code sees it.

context.summary: Any model. The vector is about the envelope, not about the content — the single `create` it carries is a legal data-type payload.

expected.notes: The test asserts the fact of rejection by `protocol.schema.json` only: a `jsonschema` ValidationError has no stable mapping to an error code, so no message text is matched. Concurrency control is a property of the request shape, not an optional feature of an implementation.
